name: Pine Valley Golf Club
town: Pine Hill (formerly the borough of Pine Valley); address 1 E Atlantic Ave, Pine Valley, NJ 08021
centre_source: centre of the course's OSM features as listed by OpenGolfAPI (39.7853315591, -74.96945858); Wikipedia's 39.789, -74.972 (39°47'20"N 74°58'19"W) lies about 450 m north-west, probably the clubhouse
architects: C. H. Alison, Hugh and Alan Wilson (holes 12-15, 1919, group led by Howard Street)
Perry Maxwell (8th green false front, left 9th green)
renovations: 1914-1915: holes 1-11 and 16-18 opened in stages; 12-15 built 1919; finished course 1922
late 1920s: thousands of trees planted to hold the sand
later minor changes by John Arthur Brown, Ernie Ransome and Gordon Brewer, with Tom Fazio (dates not found)
1992: 10-hole Short Course by Tom Fazio and Ernie Ransome
early 2000s: middle and back tees on 14 (forum report); other new back tees over time (totals 6,699 -> 7,057 -> 7,181/7,197/7,201)
tree and underbrush removal on 2, 5, 9, 10, 14 (Golf Club Atlas profile, date not given)
notable: No. 1 GOLF Top 100 in the World 2025-26
Hell's Half Acre (7th): Guinness record largest bunker
video_games: no licensed appearance found; fan-made Links 2003 recreation by Robert Miller (Links Corner, 2010)
special_ground: unraked sand played as bunkers (hazards) by the club: waste_sand off
sandy scrub / underbrush between holes (option: gorse-style scrub layer)
Hell's Half Acre across the 7th fairway
water: one lake system: carry on the 5th tee shot (pond by Crump's cabin), lake left of the 14th green (near-island green), carry on the 15th tee shot, lake left on 16, lake behind the 17th tee; all red
layouts: Short Course (10 holes, par 31; possible later layout, no per-hole card)

lidar.bare_earth: USGS 3DEP 1 m via the 3DEPElevation ImageServer; source 2015 DVRPC Lidar: Delaware Valley (USGS DE_DelawareValley_HD_2015, project Delaware_Valley_High_Density_QL2_LiDAR_BAA; NOAA DEM id 10301); tile x50y441, 1 m project name not confirmed
lidar.canopy: NOAA DAV point cloud 9119 (2015 DVRPC Lidar: Delaware Valley (PA, NJ)), clipped LAZ, UTM 18 NAD83(2011) m, NAVD88 m

imagery: NAIP (USGS National Map) at 1 m; New Jersey 2020 1 ft leaf-off natural colour (maps.nj.gov Orthos_Natural_2020_NJ_WM MapServer export, flown 2 Apr - 5 May 2020), recommended
osm_coverage: partial at least: 18 golf=hole lines with par, stroke index and dist (seen via OpenGolfAPI); other features unknown until the export
scorecard_status: third-party (Stymie), Back and Regular per hole with stroke index and men's ratings; no official card, no women's ratings; totals conflict across sources
